name: claude-uds-bridge
description: Guide Codex Desktop and Claude Desktop Code collaboration with free, research and review routines, authored results and versioned assessments.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborate, research and review with both agents.
interface.longDescription: Choose exact Desktop conversations, continue existing analyses or start new work, collaborate freely or use research/review guidance, record authored results and assessments of exact versions, preserve disagreements and export the exchange. Reception settings still apply. Optional structured coordination adds a current-run analysis barrier, context versions, pause and crash recovery. A local authenticated panel displays exchanges, results and disagreements and queues human controls for the selected Desktop chat.
interface.developerName: Jaime Bernal · based on Leon Kohli's bridge
interface.defaultPrompt: Use bridge-collaboration to contrast approaches with the Claude Desktop conversation in this project.
